title: Benny’s Treasure Quest
moral: The greatest treasure is friendship and teamwork.

scenes.summary: Benny finds a treasure map and starts an adventure.
scenes.text: Benny the bear found a secret treasure map in the forest and invited his friends Lily and Max to join him.
scenes.image_prompt: cute bear holding treasure map with rabbit and squirrel in forest, colorful cartoon

scenes.summary: They are unsure about the path and face challenges.
scenes.text: They followed the map into the mysterious woods and felt unsure about what they might encounter.
scenes.image_prompt: bear rabbit squirrel walking through dark forest, soft adventurous cartoon style

scenes.summary: They meet a wise owl and continue their path.
scenes.text: They met a wise owl who warned them about a tricky stream and guided them forward.
scenes.image_prompt: animals talking to owl on branch in forest, magical cartoon illustration

scenes.summary: They successfully cross the tricky stream together.
scenes.text: Working together, they carefully crossed the stream using stepping stones and reached the other side.
scenes.image_prompt: bear rabbit squirrel crossing stream on stones, teamwork colorful cartoon

scenes.summary: They find the treasure and realize friendship is most important.
scenes.text: They found a treasure chest with jewels and felt happy, knowing their friendship was the greatest treasure.
scenes.image_prompt: friends opening treasure chest with glowing jewels, happy cartoon forest scene

story: Benny the bear found a secret treasure map and invited his friends Lily the rabbit and Max the squirrel to join him. They followed the map into the forest and met a wise owl who warned them about a tricky stream. Working together, they crossed the stream safely using stepping stones. Finally, they found a hidden treasure chest filled with colorful jewels. They felt happy and proud, realizing that their friendship and teamwork were the greatest treasures of all.
